educational_overlay.purpose: Rapidly triage inbound NDAs into GREEN / YELLOW / RED risk categories before routing to legal counsel.
educational_overlay.when_to_use: When receiving non-disclosure agreements from vendors, partners, or counterparties during exploratory discussions.
educational_overlay.when_not_to_use: When the agreement contains restrictive post-employment covenants or complex IP assignments.

variables.label: Governing Law & Jurisdiction
variables.default: Laws of India, courts at New Delhi

educational_overlay.prompt_template:
Act as commercial legal counsel for {{CLIENT_ROLE}}.
Review the supplied NDA under {{GOVERNING_LAW}} with confidentiality term of {{TERM_YEARS}} years.
Triage risk into GREEN (standard terms), YELLOW (negotiable deviations), or RED (onerous terms).
Check non-compete/non-solicit restrictions: {{NON_COMPETE_FLAG}}.
Flag any perpetual non-disclosure obligations, asymmetric indemnity, or residuals clauses.
Mark unverified facts with [VERIFY]. Professional attorney review required before signature.
educational_overlay.fictional_scenario: Apex Software Pvt Ltd receives a unilateral NDA from CloudMatrix Inc. demanding a 5-year confidentiality period, indemnification for breach, and a clause restricting Apex from working with any competitors for 18 months.
educational_overlay.sample_output:
### NDA Triage Summary: RED (High Risk)
- **Issue 1: Non-Compete Restriction (Clause 9)**: Unilateral restriction on dealing with competitors violates Section 27 of Indian Contract Act 1872.
- **Issue 2: Asymmetric Indemnity (Clause 11)**: Unlimited indemnification for ordinary confidentiality breaches.
- **Recommended Action**: Strike Clause 9 entirely. Align confidentiality term from 5 years to standard 2-3 years.
guardrails: Never sign an NDA with post-termination non-compete clauses without partner sign-off.
Verify definition of Confidential Information covers only properly marked materials.
verification_checklist: Confirm party corporate entities match official registry.
Verify absence of IP transfer language.
educational_overlay.ai_risk_warning: AI cannot confirm whether the counterparty's business model presents direct conflict of interest.
